angle: AMC's own accounts (10-Q, quarter to Sept. 30, 2026): film exhibition costs were about 50% of admissions revenue, while food and beverage cost only about 18% of F&B revenue. In 2025, the average AMC patron spent $12.09 on admissions and $7.62 on food and drinks. The ticket gets you in; the popcorn pays the bills.
paragraphs: When you buy a movie ticket at AMC, about half of your money goes straight to the studio.
Last quarter, AMC paid studios about {fifty cents|50¢} of every ticket dollar.
Popcorn is different. For every dollar of snacks and drinks, the food itself cost AMC about {eighteen cents|18¢}.
So it keeps about {eighty-two cents|82¢} of every snack dollar, before staff and rent.
In {twenty twenty-five|2025}, the average AMC customer spent {twelve dollars|$12.09} on the ticket, and {seven sixty-two|$7.62} on snacks.
The ticket gets you in. The popcorn pays the rent. More on the channel.
